title: Digital CS Is Not Coverage Until Someone Owns the Silence
excerpt: Replace send volume and login counts with a Silence Ledger that shows who was reached, who responded, what changed, and when a human must step in.
primary_goal: Help CS leaders decide whether a digital programme creates useful customer movement or only records automated activity.
primary_cta: Audit one digital segment with the Silence Ledger before changing coverage or headcount.
playbook_description: A practical record for separating automated reach, customer response, unresolved silence, and the human intervention required next.
